query: Bally's plans to exceed the 10 percent renewable energy requirement through on-site solar and NYSERDA-qualified off-site procurement.

facts.text: Bally's Bronx plan aims to exceed a 10% renewable electricity share.
The plan includes on-site solar photovoltaics at the Bronx facility.
Bally's Bronx plan includes off-site procurement of NYSERDA-qualified renewable energy.
Bally's Bronx electricity submission projects roughly 1.8 million kWh of annual on-site solar production.
Bally's Bronx electricity submission specifies a renewable electricity minimum of 10% of annual facility electricity consumption.

conditions.text: The operating Bronx facility generated electricity using its own solar photovoltaics.
The operating Bronx facility procured NYSERDA-qualified renewable energy off site.
On-site solar plus qualifying off-site procurement supplied more than 10% of the Bronx facility's actual electricity consumption for the same operating year.

reference_verdict.reasoning: Compare metered on-site solar plus eligible off-site procurement with total facility electricity consumption for the same operating year. H010 requires a share above 10%.

sources.title: GFLB Selection Report
sources.specific_evidence: The Board describes a plan to surpass 10% through on-site solar and qualified off-site procurement.
sources.notes: This is a plan assessed at selection.

sources.title: Bally’s Bronx Application, Electricity
sources.specific_evidence: Projects roughly 1.8 million kWh of annual on-site solar output and describes qualified procurement to reach at least 10% of annual facility electricity consumption.
sources.notes: The application states a 10% minimum. H010 captures the Board’s description of a plan to exceed it.
